b is an object aggregate means: b is a material entity consisting exactly of a plurality of objects as member_parts at all times at which b exists.
An item is everything which is not a set. Also called ur-element.

Unitary and non-dissective continuant.  That is, it exists as a whole (wholly present) at any instant.  It needs substance to constitute itself. It needs an event in which it participates to exist in the real world.
An object that captures information about something.

Information objects are social objects. They are realized by some entity. They are ordered (expressed according to) by some system for information encoding. Consequently, they are dependent from an encoding as well as from a concrete realization. They can express a description (the ontological equivalent of a meaning/conceptualization), can be about any entity, and can be interpreted by an agent. From a communication perspective, an information object can play the role of "message". From a semiotic perspective, it playes the role of "expression".
تعبير يدلل ويربط موجود مادي بمعنى لموضوع ذهني، بغض النظر عن كيفية تمثيل او تجسيد هذا التعبير في الواقع
The generalized timespace object, under which all time and space objects lie.
Concrete individuals have a relation to time or space (they are in time and space).
Entities which exist independently of others.
A presential exists wholly at exactly one time boundary.

Categories satisfy the following conditions: (1) Categories can be instantiated; (2) Categories can be predicated of other entities. Categories are defined intensional-with-an-s. They are, therefore, closely related to language.
An entity which may participate in a configuration.
Some entities are just not treated by the language to be conscious. They go here.
An object that is being regarded as not possessing significant parts, or which is not to be considered decomposable for present purposes.
An entity considered for comparison as persisting, enduring, or being present through time, such as an object, quality, or role.
شيء يمثل أو يدلل على كينونات أخرى علائقياً، ويحمل معلومة بغض النظر عن كيفية تمثيل أو تجسيد هذه المعلومة
